title: Snowflake Data Warehouse Analytics Platform
raw_description: BC Hydro seeks a qualified vendor to design, implement, and support a modern cloud-based data warehouse and analytics platform using Snowflake. The successful proponent will deliver ETL/ELT pipeline development, Power BI dashboard integration, data governance frameworks, and ongoing platform administration. The engagement will support enterprise-wide reporting and advanced analytics across finance, operations, and customer experience domains.
